reference._planc_note: Plan C: a fresh Rs 5 lakh in Jan-Nov 2026 with the last-12-months order -> +108%; about 5 trades a month; 5 years compounding from Jan 2022 about +65%/yr (lower % as the pot grows: each stock only takes so much money at the open).

ticks._note: Fills outside the auction come from the tick recorder's encrypted daily files (needs the TICKS_KEY secret). The bot waits for them until these times, then falls back to minute candles and says so in the trade note.

limit_orders._note: Owner's rule from 23 Nov 2026 (research: +4.3 bps/night for A, +4.6 bps/trade for B). Plan A: at 15:20 a limit buy 1 paisa below the last traded price; filled only if the market later trades BELOW it (so we are surely filled even at the back of the queue); if not filled by 15:25, market buy at 15:25 (best ask). Plan B buy-back: same at 09:16, market at 09:17.

plan_c._stocks_note: PRIORITY order = results of the last 12 months (net profit per gap-up trade after costs, shrunk for few trades: avg x n/(n+10)), worked out 23 Nov 2026 with plan_c_order.py. Honest test 2023-26 (order re-picked every 6 months from the past only): last-12-months order averaged +180%/yr on a fresh Rs 5 lakh vs +171% for the fixed 5-year order, and +108% vs +90% in 2026. VI is still first: best of the 13 over the last 12 months (11 trades, +1.04% each, 10 of 11 won). Owner added Waaree Energies, Premier Energies and Vishal Mega Mart (established brands).
plan_c._rerank_note: Every 6 months re-rank on the last 12 months; the bot raises a GitHub issue when this date arrives.
plan_c._note: Plan C (owner approved 23 Nov 2026): gap-up auction short on a basket. Real-bot rule: limit sell at yesterday's last price x 1.02 (rounded up to the price step) in the 09:00-09:08 pre-open; it fills only if the auction price is at or above it, at the auction price (= the 09:15 minute's open). Gaps above 20% are ignored (corporate actions). Each morning up to 3 signals in priority order; each position <= 5% of the stock's median 09:15-minute traded value over the last 20 trading days (so our order would not move the price), <= Rs 50 lakh, from what is left of 5 x the Plan C account; positions under Rs 50,000 are skipped. Buy back at 09:20 at the best ask from the tick recorder (walking the depth); if the recorder missed it, the 09:20 minute's open + half a price step (at least 0.02%). Cash intraday charges. Separate from Plan B: on a VI gap-up of 2%+ both plans short VI.
